title: From TOKEN2049 to Ecosystem Co-Building: HTX Advances Its Multifaceted Engagement Across the Global Crypto Industry
summary: Singapore, October 12, 2026 – From October 6 to 8, the global crypto industry turned its attention to Singapore for TOKEN2049, a major international industry event. Taking advantage of the gathering, HTX pursued a multifaceted approach encompassing global industry engagement, ecosystem development, and brand awareness. HTX Ventures exhibited at TOKEN2049, where its booth welcomed a steady stream of visitors. HTX DAO hosted “Future Night” and “HTX DAO Reunion,” bringing together industry perspectives and community voices. Meanwhile, a private industry dinner provided an opportunity for invited industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners to connect and exchange views. From the public stage of a global summit to in-depth exchanges with ecosystem participants and face-to-face conversations with industry peers, HTX’s presence at TOKEN2049 reflected diverse efforts in industry networking, ecosystem development, and partnership building. Beyond providing opportunities for international industry engagement, these events reflected HTX’s ongoing efforts to strengthen industry connections and foster ecosystem collaboration. Taking the Global Crypto Stage: Strong Visitor Interest at the HTX Ventures Booth As a major annual event for the global crypto industry, TOKEN2049 brings together project teams, investment firms, developers, crypto exchanges, and industry builders from around the world. It serves as an important platform for tracking industry trends, forging business connections, and exploring opportunities for global collaboration. From October 7-8, HTX Ventures, HTX’s global investment arm, exhibited at TOKEN2049 at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, with its booth located at Level 5, PB5-47 and PB5-48. Throughout the event, the exhibition floor remained busy, drawing a steady stream of industry participants. The HTX Ventures booth welcomed numerous visitors, offering an engaging, interactive brand experience through brand displays, on-site community activities , and branded merchandise. These activities encouraged visitors to stop by and connect with the team, bringing the HTX brand into face-to-face interactions with members of the global crypto community. Meanwhile, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX, attended related events and delivered a speech before visiting the HTX Ventures booth to engage with the team and other industry participants, further strengthening HTX’s connections with the global crypto industry. For the crypto industry, the value of an international summit lies not only in raising brand awareness but also in building meaningful connections with industry participants. By combining booth displays, on-site activities, and industry engagement, HTX Ventures brought the brand closer to the global crypto community, creating more opportunities for connections across the investment ecosystem, project discussions, and potential partnerships. From steady visitor traffic at its booth to a diverse range of on-site activities, HTX Ventures maintained a strong presence at TOKEN2049, providing HTX with another valuable opportunity to strengthen its connections across the global crypto industry. From Industry Trends to Ecosystem Development: HTX DAO Advances Community Co-Building While the TOKEN2049 booth served as HTX’s brand showcase to the global crypto industry, the series of events hosted by HTX DAO took these conversations further, exploring broader topics such as industry trends, community building, and ecosystem development. On the evening of October 6, HTX DAO hosted the “Future Night” event in Singapore. Molly, an HTX DAO ambassador, shared the latest developments in ecosystem mechanisms, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem. Justin Sun, a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing his perspectives on trends in the crypto industry and the future development of the digital economy. Sun noted that the crypto industry is deepening its ties with traditional finance, driving the continued digital transformation of global financial infrastructure. AI is changing how wealth is created, while crypto and digital finance are reshaping how wealth is held and transferred. He further noted that stablecoins could play a greater role in global payments and settlements, while the use of traditional assets such as bonds, funds and gold on-chain will continue to evolve. As AI agents become increasingly involved in economic activity, demand for digital identities, account infrastructure, and the ability to transact autonomously is also likely to grow. In his view, the long-term value of technology lies in its ability to deliver tangible productivity gains. The free flow of value in the digital world will be a key trend to watch over the next decade. On ecosystem development, Molly said HTX DAO is exploring potential token utility and ecosystem applications, alongside other initiatives aimed at supporting the development of its ecosystem. For community building, HTX DAO plans to establish regional community hubs in the fourth quarter, enabling members to organize events, exchange ideas, and contribute to the development of the community’s culture. Nearly 200 active volunteers are already contributing to these efforts on their own initiative. To strengthen its on-chain ecosystem, HTX DAO is engaging university developers from around the world through initiatives such as hackathons. Several projects are currently being explored or developed, including potential applications within the $HTX ecosystem. Molly emphasized that ecosystem development requires a long-term commitment. HTX DAO will continue to strengthen its infrastructure, foster an active community, and drive the adoption of ecosystem applications. As an ecosystem participant, HTX continues to gather user feedback and explore improvements to its platform and user experience, with a view to better understanding and responding to evolving user needs. From discussions on industry trends to practical initiatives in community development and the on-chain ecosystem, the Future Night event highlighted HTX DAO’s sustained commitment to long-term ecosystem development health and provided a platform for global community members and industry contributors to connect and collaborate. III. From Online Communities to In-Person Gatherings: The HTX DAO Reunion Strengthens Ecosystem Connections Ecosystem growth depends not only on mechanisms and technology, but also on trust among community members and sustained collaboration among participants united by shared goals. From October 6 to 8, HTX DAO hosted the HTX DAO Reunion, bringing together industry representatives, ecosystem partners, and community members aboard a yacht for face-to-face discussions in an informal setting. Unlike traditional conferences built around structured agendas and formal presentations, the event created a more informal setting for participants to exchange views on industry trends, community development, and potential collaborations, fostering a deeper mutual understanding. For a DAO ecosystem to develop sustainably, community means more than online discussions and on-chain governance. It also depends on meaningful personal connections, ongoing exchanges, and active participation. By creating more diverse opportunities for in-person engagement, HTX DAO is strengthening its ties with community members and partners, opening up new possibilities for community-driven development, ecosystem collaboration, and future partnerships. From themed discussions to open exchanges, and from online participation to in-person engagement, HTX DAO is exploring diverse approaches to community building and continually strengthening connections among ecosystem participants. VIP Industry Gathering: Strengthening Face-to-Face Engagement with Ecosystem and Industry Partners Alongside public engagement with the global industry, HTX also made strengthening relationships with industry peers and partners a priority during Singapore Week. During the week, HTX hosted a private industry dinner attended by invited industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners. Compared with large industry summits, private gatherings provide a more personal setting for direct conversations. These face-to-face interactions allow HTX to listen more closely to partners and exchange views on industry developments, market developments and potential future collaborations. As the crypto industry evolves, fostering industry relationships requires an understanding of ecosystem developments, effective communication, and the cultivation of long-term partnerships. Face-to-face engagement helps build mutual understanding, laying the groundwork for expanded collaboration across the sector. From industry discussions at the global summit to in-depth conversations in private settings, HTX is continuously strengthening its relationships with industry partners through engagement at multiple levels. Driving Long-Term Growth Through Global Engagement: HTX Expands Ecosystem Collaboration Throughout TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, HTX engaged across multiple fronts, including global industry dialogue, ecosystem development, brand visibility, and industry networking. HTX Ventures leveraged the international summit to expand its industry network and boost brand engagement through booth activities and in-person interactions. HTX DAO explored industry trends, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem, strengthening connections with community members and developers. Meanwhile, a series of in-person events and private industry gatherings provided further opportunities for HTX to engage with industry peers, ecosystem contributors, and partners. While each initiative served a different purpose, they all contributed to the same overarching goal of building broader, deeper, and more enduring industry relationships as the global crypto industry continues to evolve. For participants in the crypto industry, brand influence stems not only from market visibility but also from sustained engagement in industry development, responsiveness to user needs, and efforts to foster collaboration among communities, projects, and partners. Looking ahead, HTX intends to continue its engagement with industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners, while exploring opportunities for ecosystem collaboration and platform improvements, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. By strengthening connections among global communities, developers, projects, and industry partners, HTX aims to explore new opportunities for the development of digital finance and blockchain ecosystems. From the global industry stage to the front lines of ecosystem development, HTX will continue to bring industry participants together through open collaboration and drive ecosystem growth through long-term commitment. title: Justin Sun Shares AI and Quantum Vision at TOKEN2049 Singapore and Blockworks DAS Asia
summary: Geneva, Switzerland, October 10, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), participated in TOKEN2049 Singapore as Title Sponsor and in Blockworks’ Digital Asset Summit (DAS) Asia 2026 at the Marina Bay Sands. TRON Founder Justin Sun joined fireside discussions at both conferences, sharing his views on stablecoins, institutional adoption, AI-driven commerce, machine-to-machine payments and the need for quantum-resilient blockchain infrastructure. On October 7, Sun joined Michael Ippolito, Co-Founder of Blockworks, on the main stage at DAS Asia 2026 for a fireside titled “In Conversation with Justin Sun.” Organized by Blockworks, DAS Asia is an institution-focused digital asset conference examining the intersection of traditional finance and the digital asset economy. The conversation covered the evolution of stablecoins, institutional adoption, agentic AI payments and TRON’s role in the global digital asset economy. Sun highlighted the growing role of tokenized assets and stablecoins as practical financial infrastructure, particularly for cross-border payments and access to digital dollars and U.S.-based assets. He also discussed the emerging role of AI agents in the economy, predicting that within the near future, AI agents will increasingly make payments, purchase digital services and manage financial activity on behalf of users. On October 8, Sun joined Kevin Follonier, Founder of When Shift Happens, for “Fireside Chat with Justin Sun” on the TOKEN2049 main stage. The discussion explored the future of blockchain, stablecoins, AI agents and the broader evolution of global finance. Sun also discussed the need to prepare blockchain networks for quantum computing, noting that TRON has already made meaningful progress toward post-quantum readiness, with end-to-end post-quantum signature support deployed on the Nile testnet. Furthermore, pointing to the mathematics behind the cryptography that secures blockchain networks, Sun turned to the Justin Sun Prize, which he describes as the “Nobel Prize of the AI Era.” Structured as a zero-trust, decentralized academic bounty mechanism built around a “problem list,” the prize recognizes breakthroughs in fundamental disciplines verified through machine formal verification. It seeks to accelerate fundamental research through collaboration between humans and AI. “AI agents using crypto will become the industry’s biggest use case within the next five years,” said Sun. “As AI agents begin to transact, pay and operate autonomously, blockchain will become the financial infrastructure behind them. TRON’s focus is to provide the fast, efficient and accessible settlement layer that can support this next generation of global finance.” TRON DAO also hosted a dedicated booth at the conference, giving attendees the opportunity to connect with the broader TRON community and learn about the ecosystem’s work across stablecoin payments, decentralized applications and AI-driven financial infrastructure. Beyond the conference floor, TRON DAO also hosted a Creators and Media Networking Happy Hour, welcoming industry leaders for an evening of light bites and conversation. Across both events, the discussions underscored TRON’s focus on building blockchain infrastructure for a rapidly evolving financial system being shaped by stablecoins, tokenized assets, AI agents and increasingly resilient digital-asset networks. About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of October 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 407 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.” TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum Media Contact Yeweon Park press@tron.network

title: MEXC and Payward Highlight Collaboration as Crypto and TradFi Converge at TOKEN2049
summary: October 9, 2026 – MEXC,a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, and Payward, the parent company of Kraken, shared their perspectives on the convergence of crypto and traditional finance during a TOKEN2049 Singapore panel. MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi, discussed how broader market access, retail demand and collaboration between platforms could shape the future of global trading. Crypto and TradFi Move Closer Together An important theme was the shift toward more connected, always-on markets. Vugar said blockchain infrastructure is challenging traditional market structures built around fixed trading hours, while users increasingly expect access to different asset classes through a more seamless experience. “Over the next five years, we’ll see a convergence toward a singular platform where asset classes and investments can move quickly and smoothly,” said Vugar. “Retail will be the main driver.” Arjun highlighted the infrastructure challenge behind this shift, noting that 24/7 trading is ultimately about bringing assets and collateral into a more connected financial environment. “24/7 trading really means: how do you bring all that collateral into one place?” said Arjun. Collaboration Over Competition Both speakers also highlighted collaboration as an important part of scaling the next generation of global trading platforms. Arjun noted that serving a much larger global user base will require platforms to work with partners that bring different strengths in their respective markets, explicitly pointing to MEXC as one such example. “The only way to do that is to partner with folks, including MEXC, to be able to help succeed in their core markets,” said Arjun. Vugar similarly emphasized that exchanges can increasingly build on one another’s strengths rather than approach every opportunity purely through competition. MEXC brings a retail-first approach, deep liquidity and broad experience in perpetual markets across crypto and TradFi assets, while Payward brings global financial infrastructure, professional trading capabilities and strong market experience in the United States. The discussion built on the two companies’ earlier indication that they are exploring broader collaboration, with both executives pointing to infrastructure, market access and distribution as areas where greater connectivity between platforms could create value. Trust and access were also highlighted as essential foundations for this evolution. Vugar described trust and access as two of the most important elements in building future financial platforms, while Arjun emphasized the importance of transparency as the industry becomes more connected. The panel pointed to a future in which crypto and TradFi become increasingly connected, with collaboration between platforms helping bring together market access, infrastructure and user reach to serve a broader global audience. About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity. title: Post-Quantum Custody Platform Strongpoint Adds Quantus As Development Partner
summary: Project Eleven and Quantus plan to integrate the Quantus Network with Strongpoint, Project Eleven's institutional custody platform for post-quantum blockchain assets. Quantus has joined as a development partner, with support targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

title: OSL Brings A USDGO Market-Neutral Fund On-Chain For Hong Kong Investors
summary: OSL Group has tokenized the USDGO Plus SP fund on-chain and is providing custody and distribution through its licensed Hong Kong platform. The product is a market-neutral digital asset fund built around USDGO and is available only to eligible professional investors.

title: PowerCompute Mines 8.1 Bitcoin In September After Using BTC To Slash Debt
summary: PowerCompute mined 8.1 BTC in September, up 37% from a year earlier. Its month-end Bitcoin holdings fell to 63.7 BTC after the company used 267.4 BTC to help retire a $22.45 million Bitcoin-backed credit facility, leaving most of its secured debt eliminated.

title: Strategy Sets October 29 Date For Its Next Major Bitcoin Treasury Update
summary: Strategy will report third-quarter 2026 results after US markets close on October 29 and hold a live webinar at 5 p.m. Eastern Time. The update will give investors the next full financial snapshot of the world's largest corporate Bitcoin treasury.

title: BNY Expands Regulated Crypto Custody Across The European Union Under MiCA
summary: BNY has expanded its Digital Asset Custody platform to selected institutional clients across the European Union under MiCA. The move follows the addition of its European banking entity to the ESMA MiCA register and gives one of the world's largest custody banks a regulated route to hold and administer crypto assets in the region.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $484.9 Million As BlackRock Leads A Broad Day Of Outflows
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $484.9 million in net outflows on October 7, according to Farside Investors. BlackRock's IBIT led the withdrawals with $207.7 million leaving the fund, while Fidelity and ARK also posted nine-figure outflows.

title: Polygon Opens Its Money Stack To TRON’s $94 Billion USDT Market
summary: Polygon Open Money Stack now supports TRON, giving payment and fintech businesses a single infrastructure layer for bank transfers, wallets, cross-chain routing and payouts involving TRC-20 USDT. Polygon says more than $94 billion of USDT currently circulates on TRON.
